decisions.question: The refine phase has completed. Please review the analysis and approve to continue, or provide feedback to request changes.

agents_spawned.task_context: Issue #1032: Agent anchor mechanism for post-compaction state recovery. This is a well-specified enhancement issue that defines a persistent anchor mechanism so agents maintain coherent state after context compaction. The issue includes detailed design decisions (JSON format, 2KB/3KB size budget, self-report + orchestrator enrichment, anchor-as-floor recovery, lifecycle-based cleanup, gateway enforcement). Key deliverables: JSON schema at .egg/schemas/agent-anchor.schema.json, Python library at shared/egg_anchor/, egg-orch anchor CLI subcommands, orchestrator API endpoints, gateway phase filter additions, sandbox recovery rules, checkpoint integration. 4 implementation phases defined. Dependencies: soft on #1027 (cross-agent comms) and #1030 (agent roster). 3 open questions on Redis namespace, auto-pruning, and non-pipeline mode. Your job: refine the requirements, validate completeness, identify gaps or ambiguities, and produce a refined specification ready for planning.

Issue #1032: Agent anchor mechanism for post-compaction state recovery. Review the refiner's output for completeness, correctness, and clarity. The issue defines a persistent anchor mechanism (JSON files at .egg-state/agent-anchors/) for agents to recover working state after context compaction. Key areas to validate: schema design, size budgets (2KB/3KB soft/hard), recovery protocol (pull-based with message catch-up), storage architecture (local files + Redis + orchestrator API), lifecycle management, gateway enforcement (session-scoped writes). Check for gaps in error handling, edge cases (concurrent writes in shared worktree, network partitions), and integration points with existing systems (egg-contract, checkpoints, BRC consensus, cross-agent messaging). 3 open questions need resolution: Redis namespace, auto-pruning, non-pipeline mode.

Issue #1032: Agent anchor mechanism for post-compaction state recovery. Review the agent design aspects of this feature. Focus on: 1) Agent-level state management patterns - is the anchor schema capturing the right state for recovery? 2) Recovery protocol - is pull-based recovery with standing instructions in sandbox/.claude/rules/anchor-recovery.md sufficient given Claude Code's opaque compaction? 3) BRC integration - does the brc_state section in anchors properly mirror PeerConsensusTracker? 4) Team anchor design - is orchestrator-generated projection the right approach vs agent-written? 5) Size budgets - is 2KB sufficient for complex multi-agent coordination state? 6) Cross-agent reads - filesystem in shared worktree vs API - security and consistency implications. 7) Consensus wrapper integration for recovery prompt extension. Validate the design against the async team model from issues #1027, #1028, #1030.
